background: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Wells Fargo, one of the four largest US banks, with the largest branch network in the country, serving consumers, small businesses and corporates across the United States.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch downgrade on 7 Feb 2018. Tier 1 leverage of 8.0% is in the top quarter of US banks and LCR of 122% above the peer median, while CET1 of 12.1% is below the median. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 1.2 points and Tier 1 leverage 0.9 points, in figures to 30 Sep 2026.
